# Audit Utilities

Current user's audit records and Excel export.

2 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

## Operations

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/Audits`](#op-audits-getusertrails) | Audits_GetUserTrails |
| GET | [`/api/Audits/export`](#op-audits-exportexcel) | Audits_ExportExcel |

<a id="op-audits-getusertrails"></a>
### GET `/api/Audits`

operationId `Audits_GetUserTrails` · Retrieves audit trail records for the current authenticated user

Parameters: _none_

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfListOfAuditResponse](#schema-resultoflistofauditresponse) | User audit trails retrieved successfully |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have AuditTrails.View permission and be authenticated |
| `500` | [ResultOfListOfAuditResponse](#schema-resultoflistofauditresponse) | Internal server error while retrieving audit trails |

<a id="op-audits-exportexcel"></a>
### GET `/api/Audits/export`

operationId `Audits_ExportExcel` · Exports audit trail data to Excel format with optional search filtering

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `searchString` | query | string |  | default `""`; Optional search string to filter audit records |
| `searchInOldValues` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); default `false`; Whether to include old values in the search |
| `searchInNewValues` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); default `false`; Whether to include new values in the search |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Excel export generated successfully |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have AuditTrails.Export permission |
| `500` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Internal server error during export generation |
